---
title: "Live demo"
output: rmarkdown::html_document
---

This is the demo app of `bones`, running in your browser. There is no
server: [shinylive](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/) runs R and
Shiny in the page with webR. The first start downloads R and the packages,
so it can take half a minute. Later visits start faster.

Things to try:

* Open each tab. Its outputs load when the tab first shows, and each one
  shows a skeleton in the shape of its content first.
* Press **Load new data**. With **stale** on, the content stays and dims.
  Turn **stale** off and press again: the skeletons come back.
* Set the load time below 0.3 seconds. A load that fast shows nothing, so
  the page does not flicker.
* Change the animation, or turn on the dark mode with the moon.

```{=html}
<div class="bones-live-demo">
  <iframe src="../demo/" title="bones live demo" loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
<p class="small text-muted">
  <a href="../demo/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the demo in a new tab</a>
</p>
```

To run the same demo on your own machine:

```r
shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/demo", package = "bones"))
```
